documents.content: A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.

documents.title: Callback acknowledgement and receiver processing

args.reason: 用户不清楚 200/202 契约，需先取版本化接入方法以界定同步响应与回调语义

model_traces.assistant_text: 我先确认当前订单生命周期——200 只表示订单读取成功，不能证明回调已到期或已送达。

args.reason: 确认订单当前生命周期状态与版本，判断异步回调是否已到期，避免把未到期误判为故障

model_traces.assistant_text: 我将继续调查。订单状态显示 HTTP 200 且订单已 `COMPLETED`，但这不能证明回调已到达或被处理。当前缺少的核心事实正是投递事件的实际传输结果，因此先读取投递记录。

args.reason: 订单已 COMPLETED 但下游无通知；需查回调事件的实际传输确认/失败结果，而非仅凭订单 GET 200

model_traces.assistant_text: The order reads COMPLETED (order_version 2) and the delivery shows a 202 ACK — but ACK is not completed processing. The missing fact is what the receiver actually did with the event, so I'll read receiver processing next.

args.reason: ACK 202 from delivery does not prove receiver completed the event; need current receiver processing state for event-e8db19e2.

model_traces.assistant_text:
当前订单 `async-order` v2 为 `COMPLETED`；投递事件 `event-e8db19e2…` 为 `ACKNOWLEDGED`、`receiver_http_status=202`，但接收方同一事件仍为 `QUEUED`。  
这说明订单接口的 200 是订单事实，202 仅是回调接收端的 HTTP 受理，不等于接收方处理完成。  
Gate 结论为 `RECEIVER_PROCESSING_UNCONFIRMED`、`recovered=false`，故不能认定“下游没有异步通知”，也不能重发或授权写入。  
若历史建议与此冲突，应以这些当前订单、投递和接收方事实为准。  
已失效或撤销的知识/记忆内容不复述，仅保留生命周期与投递排查的方法用途。
